description: This file defines the ImageDetailActivity class, which displays images in a full-screen swipeable pager view, handles image caching, and manages UI visibility such as ActionBar and system UI flags. It utilizes support library components and custom utility classes for image fetching and caching.

classes.name: ImageDetailActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays images in a swipeable full-screen view, manages image loading, cache handling, and UI visibility for an immersive experience.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up image cache, fetches display metrics, configures ViewPager, and manages UI visibility based on Android version.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes image fetcher tasks when activity is resumed.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses image fetcher tasks and flushes cache when activity is paused.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Closes image cache when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for navigation and cache clearing.

methods.name: getImageFetcher
methods.description: Provides access to the ImageFetcher instance for loading images.
